name: domain-intel-mcp
display_name: Domain Intel (DNS, SSL, RDAP, email security)
description: Domain health and security report: DNS, SSL/TLS, RDAP/WHOIS, SPF/DMARC/MTA-STS, HTTP/HSTS.
long_description: Health and security report for any domain: DNS records, the SSL/TLS certificate, RDAP registration data, email anti-spoofing setup (SPF, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI) and homepage HTTP behaviour (redirects, HSTS), ending with a list of detected issues. No API key needed.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Full health and security report for one domain.

tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Same report as check_domain for up to 20 domains at once (duplicates are removed).

tools.name: email_security
tools.description: Email deliverability/anti-spoofing check: SPF (record, 'all' qualifier, DNS lookup count >10), DMARC (policy, rua), MTA-STS, MX records, plus the issues found. Useful before cold outreach or when emails land in spam.

tools.name: ssl_certificate
tools.description: SSL/TLS certificate details for a host: issuer, subject names, valid from/to, days to expiry, chain validity, hostname match and negotiated TLS protocol.

tools.name: domain_expiry
tools.description: Registration and certificate expiry for up to 20 domains: registrar, domain expiry date and days left, SSL expiry and days left. Handy for monitoring a portfolio of domains.
